release_gate_doc: Owner release targets. Durations are minutes, error limits are counts, and perf R2 is milliseconds. Upgrade boots retain their separate one-minute observation.
boot_check_doc: Recorded checkstart default; checkstart itself retains its current CLI default. This is separate from release soak and upgrade observation durations.
benchmark_doc: Owner target load. Budgets remain provisional until measured at this load; this metadata does not establish multiplayer acceptance.
